Alex P: Quick share — made a 90s objective-framing checklist for managers to help ICs write crisp OKRs and self-review lines. Drop feedback. https://notion.so/redwood/obj-checklist :memo:
Jamie R: Love it, can you paste a 1-line example for an engineering objective?
Alex P: sure — checklist + samples below
Alex P: Checklist (90s):
- Start with outcome, not activity
- Quantify target or signal of success
- Add timeframe (quarter)
- Mention primary metric or customer impact
- Single owner named

Alex P: Example objective (eng): "Reduce model inference cost per 1M tokens by 30% by EOY to lower production unit economics"
Jamie R: Nice. what's a 1-line manager feedback for that?
Alex P: Manager microfeedback: "Great focus on unit economics — consider adding a sub-KR for latency risk mitigation (p95 target)"
Priya S: Can we get a self-review starter for this objective?
Alex P: Self-review starter: "Led effort to reduce inference unit cost by 30% via batching & quantization; delivered 18% reduction so far, on track — next steps: validate 8-bit quant across regressions"
People Ops Bot: Reminder: add the final OKR to the team template before EOD Friday
Jamie R: Minor edit suggestion: swap 'by EOY' -> 'this quarter' depending on timeline
Alex P: Good call, updated doc link: https://notion.so/redwood/obj-checklist?v=abc123
Priya S: Thanks! Will use as baseline for my self-review. :thumbsup:
Alex P: happy to iterate — ping me if you want one tailored to your role
Jamie R: Can you export a quick paste block we can drop into Slack for 1:1s?
Alex P: Paste block:
```
Objective: [one-liner outcome + metric]
Why it matters: [customer/financial impact]
Owner: [name]
Timeframe: [Q#]
Quick self-review starter: [one-liner progress + next step]
```
Priya S: perfect. saving.
Alex P: cool, closing thread. :sparkles:
